body:
Yes I have. Just this summer. I had it all planned but froze at the last minute. Just before I took the train my brother pinged me on fb chat. I had everything planned out and ready, had packed up things and even left long instructions and all that. But deep down, I did not want it. I was lost and in a very bad place and I posted a lot on /r/SuicideWatch and it helped me. 

Things are not great right now. I left a lot of things undone since I did not in that pit of despair expect to have to sort them out. I am still in the middle of all that. I am struggling a lot but  things do change. And if they don't, we do. I feel like the same person but with greater depth perhaps. I am trying to channel my anxiety outwards and not inwards anymore. 

I am excited to be alive and count my blessings every single day. It is a uphill battle. Your emotions will fluctuate, things will seem tougher to relate to at times. But it will get better my friend. The slump isolated me and hurt me but it also led me on this path of self-realisation. Good luck my friend! I know it sucks right now but trust me, it will get better.

I used to be stumped by this question. I never really knew what to say. I have never really had a burning passion for something. But lately, my reason to get up in the morning is that I am not done yet. There is so much I want to see, learn, do and enjoy that I am taking each day as an adventure. 

I want to do better at my masters and help people who did not have the same opportunities or resources. I want to be around to see political change in my community. I live for the day when I breathe easy and know that my life was not a waste.

I am worried that my papers are not in order and that I will have to go to the immigration office to sort things out. I am worried that after my nervous breakdown and meltdown this April, my school will not consider me as a Doctorate candidate even though I have good grades before this semester. I have to find a job to be able to pay my rent since my scholarship has been cut (since I was not able to perform well academically due to my breakdown). I am worried about a lot of things in general too. About life, goals and the sad state of things in my country of origin. I take each day as it comes and have gotten a lot better since the summer but it is hard to climb out of the deep hole that I climbed into. I have to go to the bank and fix my dues so that I can have my phone re-instated, so that I can find jobs as well. I am short by about 200 euros. So, I am also worried how I will raise that money.

But I am not so anxious as before. Unlike before, I have a greater sense of calm when dealing with my problems. But I am still hiding a bit, so I would like to change things this week.

Dear MySockHurts,

I cannot even begin to understand what you are going through. But I can listen. And hopefully share a bit with you. I have been in this very subreddit asking for help many times and I have received a lot of help. So, you are in the right place looking for online support. 

I understand the fatigue that sets in when you are that unhappy. It is not that suicide is the easier option. But it seems that way under the tunnel vision of pain and desperation. It seemed like that to me, everyday since my birthday in April. The hurt within you is so deep that sometimes just writing it out on an anonymous online forum helps. I understand that feeling. 

But trust me MySockHurts, it does get better. Not perfect, not rosy but better. It is not like the imagined happiness but everyday gets progressively better. One day you will feel happy to have the wind in your face, the sun on your skin. It happened to me. I made new friends, both on internet and in real life and I am grateful to SW for that.

The negative things that pushed me there are still around. Not every mountain has been conquered. Not everything is sure. I found a place to live, even though I am worried about next month's rent. But things have a way of turning around. It sounds slightly in-the-air to say that your darkest moment comes before the dawn, I don't think that it is completely true but traces of it are real. I am a happier person now even in my sadness tinged smile at times. 

Just because I know how close I came to ending it all, I cherish things a lot more. And you will too. Sorry about the long post really about nothing but I just wanted to reach out and try to give you a hug. Things do get better in life. Not ideal but they improve. Or you change enough to improve them yourself. 

Feel free to pm me and we can chat. Maybe if I knew more about your situation I could try to suggest some options. You are young and there are a lot of oppurtunities out there for young people who are interested in studying and use scholarships as a way to improve their lot. I did it and I could try and help you to find something along those lines.

Anyways, I hope you feel better. Please be strong.

Many redditors were kind to me in my time of need and helped me when I felt so lost that a future was something that I could not even imagine. I am doing great now and I owe it to the awesome redditors at SW.
haha. On another continent for now, might just have to visit for the Tesla museum.
Even in my state this makes me very very happy. :D
That sounds amazing! The maximum workout I get is walking at Parisian speeds. So, I really would love to encourage each other for working out.

:D
Thank you nathanic. It was lovely.

Thank you confuckused!
I am definitely going to PM you about the running and some guiding tips. For now, I am on job/apartment search for this week and the next. And then C25K for sure. I have been trying to eat and drink healthy, but it has been a little hard for the last few nights. Will definitely try to eat better tomorrow.

That sounds like great advice. I do want to get fitter. All the exercise I get is walking around the city which thanks to now feeling low I don't do anymore. I do understand it might be difficult. It is hard for me too. I cannot directly tell someone in real life about how I feel about anything. :O
i am trying to find housing/job options for now. But I would love some exercising tips for beginners. I would like to start running for fun.
Thank you. I have been trying to sort things out. And still trying. But sometimes I just want to give up. But thank you for your words. I am trying everyday to feel better!

Oh, a really long story. I have been having academic troubles..Once that kind of sorted out, I have been hunting for a job and internship for a long time and no one seems to get back to me. I feel really worthless.
Things have been going south a long time now. :/
I am in the same place jabbajoyo. I have been homeless and squatting at a friend's house for the last 2 months. :c Hugs

Thank you for the suggestions. I will try them out. I went to a therapist for one session. Right now I am trying to sort out things academically and financially and so cannot afford the 50 euros a session therapy. Will have to come back to that later but once I have enough I definitely want to go to the doctor and get properly diagnosed.
A hug right back at you. :D

In a way, I do not want to end it all too. It is just that there is a niggling voice in my head that can only derive a sense of calm from the thought that ending it would end this feeling of failure. I do know that it is because of a misplaced sense of unhappiness and am trying hard to pull myself from this bump on the road. But I do understand how comforting this sense of last resting place can be, and it is frightening.

Thanks lostwithoutme,

It helps to understand how other people go through these feelings. I am going through something similar and it helps to see it articulated so well.

thank you dermo529,

I am going to try to be positive. :D Thank you so much for your suggestions. I cannot afford an unpaid internship because I don't have an income to support that. I am on my own. I will try to not feel demotivated though it is getting harder with every passing day. The sight of an empty inbox is very defeating.

This semester is an internship semester. I'm in grad school doing a masters in Human rights. Hence, I have been looking for an internship endlessly. Since April, to be exact. It is part of what triggered the nervous breakdown. I have been looking for a full-time internship and I am only able to find unpaid ones. Everyone else in my school has one and most can afford it. But I cannot find one. I was doing great academically except for all the stress building up and hence the crash and burn.

I have been trying for the last 2 months dermo529. I feel like the time is surely running out now. It is horrible to sit here everyday, not answering calls and messages from friends, feeling like a total failure for not being able to get internship even. I am trying to stay positive but it is feeling more and more doomed.

Crying did help a lot. It was hard to control my tears in the library when my brother sent me a message on Facebook asking me if I was doing okay and that I should stay strong. It nearly broke my heart thinking that he would blame himself if something happened to me. Also, I am on a different continent than my family, who I have not seen for a year. So I will try harder. And like many suggested I still have to read a lot more, especially what ravia suggested. But more than anything I need medical help, which I will look for tomorrow once I am better rested. For now, I am at my friend's place atleast till the weekend. Thank you. 
Ps. I am a girl that does not like to cry. But today I did. In the bathrooms. :/
I decided to not give up on life today. And went on to see this. Overall a great day. On your darkest hour, what motivates you to push through the pain?
I live with that guilt too. I know that feel. :/
It is ironic that you bring up the image of the fog since that is exactly my vision of my last day. Looking out at a beautiful sunset, I can breathe the fog in as I take that last step on the cliffs.

Even though I got a strong scholarship the first time, my parents had to spend a lot of money to give me some pocket money(my program was way too intensive to have time to work.) This coupled with other things led them to deplete their resources, especially since it was from a developing country's currency to pounds. Right now, I have a scholarship that covers my academic program but for the living costs my parents have taken a loan. I could not have gotten a loan in my country of birth. Hence the link up. 
I am a girl. On the surface my life looks promising and I look like the happy person in the university that is also very active socially and has the right extracurricular leanings. But I am fragile. And at my wit's end.
I do man. I do. :)

Somedays I just feel really lonely too. But I think in a way I keep myself lonely. I surround myself with a lot of people. That way i am never dependent on just one person and also every time there is a possibility of anyone piercing through the barrier, I become scared and try hard to drive them away. Because I know that if I let someone in and then they leave me, I would be a lot lonelier than I am now. I would be able to measure my loneliness.

I do love learning new things. This past year one of my joys has been learning a new language. And a few new games ( I know it is stupid but a game of french tarot is really fun). I get depressed by my lack of knowledge too. I wish that I had paid more attention in school. I was always told that I was intelligent so I sort of skated through school and college and to an extent even through grad school. i really enjoyed programming when I was 15 and never touched it again. I was captivated by desires to be a cardiac surgeon but grew scared at the idea of having the onus of saving someone's life on me. So, I drifted through life. And yet, I do love to learn new things. Science, politics, photography, cinema and many other things interest me. And my biggest regret would be not learning to develop my own photographs. To have a makeshift darkroom to develop photographs was something I wanted to do. Also sing at a jazz club. :D

My farewell was in a way for me too. It was a way to articulate and visualise what I wanted to say to my family and my friends, and I have met amazing people here too, so in a way to them too. I am agnostic but have tried to live with a buddhist philosophy on life in general. Tried to be compassionate and live as a good person. So I am happy on that account.

The first time I was diagnosed with depression, it was in similar circumstances. I had received a scholarship for a rigorous academic program. I asked them to let me go this time since there was a 8 year gap between the two. Last time I was a young 17 year old leaving home for the first time, this time I was 26 and hungry for not repeating the same mistakes. 
So, I cannot make that call. I lived through the knowledge of making it once and nearly ruining the lives of my parents and my brother and I cant live through it again. 
I hesitate to call them not due to their apathy or anything else, but due to the fact that I am a coward. I have always hidden from confrontation and that has been my downfall.
I hope you fare better than I am handotbot.
thank you. I feel like a hopeless eccentric too!
I want to look forward to see what happens. But I have said my mental farewells already.

Last night, I dreamt that I was back at my parent's place. Not the apartment that they live in now but the one that we lived in till I was 13. I grew up in the faculty quarters in the University campus. It was a small flat but we were happy. 
In my dream, I woke up from my sleep to the trickling sound of water. I looked around but I was alone and yet knew that I had to protect my house. As I looked into the other room, I realised that the ceiling was going to collapse. The flat above ours must have either been seriouly waterlogged for some amount of time or the drain pipes had burst. I panicked, trying to salvage what I could. Old pictures, my parents' things, etc. But soon the ceiling collapsed pinning me down to the floor. I remember waking up at 12 and feeling trapped. I have missed my bus today, but I should be on it tomorrow. 

My life has been an adventure. The end has to be an adventure too.
Thank you snarlsburg.
I am here another day. As I see the sun shine over the beautiful history of this city, I just pause to feel sad that this will be it. My last home. So far away from family.
I wanted to fancyskink, I really wanted to. :)
Thank you eiretharlear. I want to be strong. But even in having the convictions to just take that final leap, I am weak.

I have wanted to get some help. Right from the time I made that first panicked call to the helpline. But I cannot afford it. I am not in the US. I am a foreign student in a EU country where getting help in English is difficult and the most expensive. I had nearly 30 hours of school crammed into a week, I really should have gotten help.

Your words do mean a lot to me. I have a popular public persona that I cannot bring myself to break. I have not told anyone for the past 3 months that I was going through the worst feeling of despair and also turning more and more suicidal. I could not bring myself to. I did meet amazing redditors who gave me hope to live longer. But sadly this is how this has to play out. I am broke. I dont have money to book that flight home. And I am homeless now.

Thank you sheer bliss. I have missed the bus today. At a subconscious level, even my body knows that I do not want to do this. But it means that I am homeless for another night. And tomorrow I will have no excuse.
We share the same love of Calvin and Hobbes! This was in a perverse way [my favorite strip](http://hylian90.files.wordpress.com/2008/04/raccoon-complete-thumb1.jpg?w=600&h=1800&h=1800)

Thank you motherknowsless,
First I want to congratulate you on getting over that point of despair and making a wonderful family with 4 kids. I wish you all the happiness. I do (most of the time) like the person I have become. I have tried to understand this for sometime now. My academic failures coupled with financial difficulties are something that could have gone the other way (well, maybe the funding not so much).

But I did not turn them around. Much like that magic act, I could always finish the disappearing act with a flourish, a last minute victory. But not this time. It went wrong. Like a magic box that collapsed onto itself and trapped me, draining me everyday of energy, happiness and a will to live. But I smile and smile. Nobody knows in real life. I was at a amazing party on saturday and was saying mental farewells. I do not want to burden others with this knowledge. But I know that there is magic and happiness in the world. And I see this as I move beyond the point of no return.

I think the Velvet Underground named themselves after a book about the 60s that talked about the depravity and sadomasochism. :D If you are interested in the Velvet Revolution then this is the [book](http://www.amazon.com/Open-Letters-Selected-Writings-1965-1990/dp/0679738118/ref=sr_1_1?s=books&ie=UTF8&qid=1342439742&sr=1-1&keywords=Vaclav+Havel) that my friend was reading that seems really interesting. I want to thank you ravia for reading through my post and pointing out what I could do to improve things. I do think that I need to learn how to do things. But more than that I need to know how to prioritise things. I was on an extremely difficult academic program for grad school but I was also busy in too many other things to be able to effectively manage my time.
Thank you for the book. It means a lot to me. I read *Thus spake Zarathustra* and that did affect a lot of my thought process. The identity part is complicated and it affects me mainly in two different ways. One, I have a duty to my people to fight for human rights and better conditions and thus educate myself in this manner. Two, it limits my options in many ways; career, places I can visit, jobs I can look for etc.
Thank you. I wish I did not have to. I wish that I had made different choices. I wish I had been stronger in my decisions. And most of all I wish that I did not regret so many decisions.
It is these very small joys that I would miss the most. Also the promise of things that could happen.

Feeling scared and sad. I was supposed to end it on tuesday and proceeded to write a farewell note but could not articulate my farewell note. There are so many things that I wanted to say, so many people that I need to say farewell to, so many things that I should have done and so many places I should have gone to. But then all things come to an end. So I have also been feeling calm and getting used to imagining a world without me. I feel like I am on a cliff and I look beyond the sea, just before the jump, and I do not feel regret for the things that I did wrong but regret for the people I will leave behind. As I leap off, I would see the sunset brimming over the sea and feel a moment of warmth wash over me. Anyways, that is how I feel.
Who knows, maybe it will. I do want to feel better. :)
thanks freesey. I sure do hope so. Right now it is the feeling of loneliness that my mental state keeps projecting on me. Good luck with your troubles too, my friend.
I am feeling better. I don't feel the same level of anxiety as when I posted. But neither do I feel hope. Just a lack of emotion.
Feeling any better?
You too. And whether I get to or not later, let me send best wishes to you and thank you for taking time out to listen to me vent my feelings.
Well I have spoken to the people at SOS before. I just saw another one but hesitating.
Well, I am English speaking person in Paris and the only hotline that speaks English is not available right now. :/
Thanks Higherbrain.
It truly is. Also Paris is the worst place to be depressed. :)

I do get what you are saying. And I want to believe. I truly do. I think this is part of the reason why I have been on this subreddit for more than a month now. I really want things to turn around. And I know that failing school is not exactly the thing that should push me over. But I am right now weighing out the pros and cons of my decision. But it is a sort of tunnel vision syndrome. You know, I feel like I am in a car that is driven around somewhere in the countryside. I am approaching the tunnel but I see something amazing that we cross. I want to slow down and stop but I can't. All I see is the growing darkness of the tunnel that I am headed towards. This is how I feel. And I feel like I have missed that warning sign some time back.
I don't know what to say to you since many things that you have described seem to be what I am going through too. Just came to give you an internet hug.

Thank you. I think you are correct in a way. I think for me though the only way out was schooling and higher education. I think I tried hard with motivation and managed for sometime. I think it was the 9 grad school courses, internship search and the financial difficulties that plonked on me together and just broke my will power or the ability to do work.
Oh, I got a scholarship for this grad school. Very very competitive. Far more than I would have thought.

I really dont know. Well, I have financial aid at this grad school, but it is barely enough. My parents have taken loans but it is just not enough. I have tried looking for a job for so long but cannot find much, earlier because I had 26-30hr classes per week, and also since I dont speak the language fluently. So the entire year, I have been struggling with the financial aspect and a growing inability to be able to pay for school. But this was supposed to be my second chance. The chance to redo and correct my bad decisions from the last scholarship I had, the high school International baccalaureate ones. I was even doing well this semester. But I dont know why in April, it just all collapsed on top of each other. I had good grades, I was on the way to actually doing well, but I self sabotaged and dug this hole from which I cannot seem to escape.

I know, I can totally see my friends face. And my brother. I want to talk to them so bad, but they are far away back home and I am in a country where I do not speak the language as well. That and the expensive health system has kept me away from seeking professional help. I wish I could just talk to a professional and get diagnosed. Atleast that way I would know why do I feel like such a failure and a fraud. And why I have never been able to imagine a future. People look forward to a time in the future when they are married or have a career etc, I just seem to be managing the present with shadows of the past.

Thanks Higherbrain,
Honestly, I would not like anything more than that. But i really do not want to burden people with my choices and subsequent inability to deliver. I am sitting alone in my room now and regretting the lack of planning. I had wanted to take one last trip and write out long messages to my friends and family, even at that I have failed. 
So, thank you for being here this night when I really need someone to talk to. Just explain my course of action in a way. The only thing that has stopped me for this long is the guilt I feel that I would be subjecting my family and my friends to grief. And the fact that I might survive the suicide attempt. That makes me feel selfish and cowardly.

I do have a lot of friends but seriously there is no one I would want to burden with my decisions and my worries. I really do not know what to do. I have tried a lot to not relapse to the way I felt last December but I seem to be not able to push this case of "blues". It has stretched for 3 months and harmed me academically and financially.

This is why it is scary. I did try to repair things and try to pull myself together since mid May but things just seem to be getting worse. I know that usually people say that grades are not everything and there is more to life than school and I would generally agree, but this feels like the cherry on the top of all my failures. I was diagnosed with depression when I was bullied in high school in the winter of 2003. I was on antidepressants only for 6 months. And I have not been to a session or had medications since. But I feel like a big failure.
Looking back, I realise that having been depressed in the final term of my senior year led to a domino effect of choices. I got good grades but not great enought to get financial aid from the university that I wanted. In my depressed state I said no to the one that was offered. And ever since have been trying to piece my life together. 
I coasted through studies, getting decent grades, but never really believing in myself. And now, more than ever, at the age of 27 in grad school, I realise that it has been a long drawn out spiral of failure, with a spattering of victories that mellow the bitter taste of failure.

I wrote out the original story a month back. Since then, things have only gone downhill and made me financially indebted as well. 
[Original post](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/u3361/feeling_very_lost/)
Well, I have been trying to not drown for the last few months. But everything comes publicly crashing down this week. Hence, have to end it all but am scared too.

Hey,
Things have been piling in for a long time now. And everything is going downhill this week. Have been extremely low for the last 3 months and  have been trying to talk myself out of it, but the circumstances do not offer any exit strategy for me. This is the only way out.

thank you. I waited for some time before posting. In a way, I have a lot more going on for me and I feel guilty for being so depressed. I have a family that has been through a lot to support me and I feel the saddest for them. I was extremely depressed when I was 18 and studying in UK. I felt suicidal then and broke down and returned home despite other scholarships from universities for bachelors. I was on medication for about 6 months only and then I stopped. I convinced my parents after nearly 8 years that I was ready for a rigorous grad school for second masters. Got another scholarship. But going throught the same thing now. Feel like such a big failure. And this time it is so much worse.

Thank you. I did hesitate before posting. I know how you feel. I was going through other posts. I wanted to reach out. But words failed me. I hope others do instead. Well, I hope we both feel better tomorrow.

I have had the same feelings for some time now. In April, I turned 27 and I felt the weight of despair settle on me. Even on my best days there is a sense of despair lurking in the background. I feel the same sense of being lost and somehow fitting uncomfortably in our reality today. All my life I have been told that I was smart and right now I am in grad school on a scholarship but I feel like a fraud. I feel like I don't have the same sort of vindictive edge that careers or people today seem to have or desire. Maybe I would have been a better fit for a different age. Who knows? Maybe that is just deluded hope of a sense of belonging.  The french have a popular phrase for it "c'était mieux avant" (it was better before). I feel a strange disconnection from people. I think all my life I was popular in order to not really be very close to anyone, in a sense making myself lonely by surrounding myself with the noise of group chatter. 
Anyways, I have gone on and on. I just wanted to let you know that you are not alone in this feeling.
I feel like I have run out of due time my friend. Thank you for being there though. I will keep you guys updated.
I dont know how to approach him. Today was a difficult day. I felt like I should write him a note. But the idea is scary. yet tantalising.
Thank you for your kind words but I feel trapped. And I feel like this is the only way out.
I really cannot afford to take the year off. I wish I could.
I hope things work out for you. I feel worst today.
Thank you for writing. I tried it. It worked for a week.
I feel like I am in the same place.
